name: ted_eu-mcp
description: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: `query` is sent verbatim as the TED EXPERT query (PublicExpertSearchRequestV1.query: 'Expert search query to filter and sort notices'); plain words are refused with QUERY_SYNTAX_ERROR ('expecting {NOT, IN, '!=', '=', '~', '!~', COMPARISON_OPERATOR}'). Use the full-text field documented in api-v3.yaml: FT~"<words>" (e.g. FT~"cloud hosting"), or a field search such as notice-title~"software", combinable with AND/OR, e.g. (FT~"software") AND (classification-cpv=72000000). `category` and `min_budget` are not sent. scope=ACTIVE restricts to active notices; page/limit paginate (limit ≤ 250). The fixed `fields` list is what the vocabulary needs; `title` is notice-title.eng and `buyer` buyer-name.eng[0] (i18n maps keyed by ISO 639-2 language — null when the notice has no English text; other languages stay in `raw`), `url` links.html.ENG, `deadline` the first deadline-receipt-tender-date-lot (null on older notices). Total = totalNoticeCount.
